service_details.title: Real Estate Development
service_details.featured_alt: Real estate development project by Salam Properties
about_paragraphs: We engage as early as possible, typically during the conceptual or schematic stage, so every decision adds long-term value. From land assessment and feasibility to design coordination and handover, Salam Properties manages the complete development lifecycle with transparency and precision.

Our multidisciplinary team combines local market knowledge with international standards, delivering residential and commercial developments that are beautiful, functional, and built to last. Every project is guided by rigorous budgeting, quality assurance, and clear communication at each milestone.

why.heading: Why Choose Us
why.description: Four decades of combined expertise, a proven delivery track record, and a client-first process that keeps your investment secure from blueprint to handover.

items.title: End-to-End Delivery
items.desc: Single-point accountability from land acquisition and permits through construction, marketing, and final handover.

items.title: Strong ROI Focus
items.desc: Data-driven site selection and cost planning designed to maximise returns and protect your capital.

items.title: Trusted & Transparent
items.desc: Clear contracts, regular progress reporting, and full financial transparency at every stage of the build.

items.title: Quality Craftsmanship
items.desc: Premium materials, vetted contractors, and multi-stage quality checks ensure a finish that endures.

offerings.title: Feasibility & Market Study
offerings.desc: Detailed site analysis, demand research, and financial modelling before a single brick is laid.

offerings.title: Land Acquisition & Approvals
offerings.desc: End-to-end support with due diligence, title verification, zoning, and government approvals.

offerings.title: Design & Planning Coordination
offerings.desc: Architect and engineer coordination to optimise density, livability, and construction cost.

offerings.title: Construction Oversight
offerings.desc: On-site supervision, contractor management, and milestone-based quality assurance.

offerings.title: Sales, Marketing & Handover
offerings.desc: Go-to-market strategy, buyer management, documentation, and a seamless handover experience.

faqs.question: What types of developments does Salam Properties handle?
faqs.answer: We deliver residential towers, gated communities, commercial plazas, mixed-use developments, and bespoke private builds across Bangladesh.

faqs.question: How early should I involve your development team?
faqs.answer: The earlier the better. Engaging us during land selection or the conceptual stage unlocks the biggest savings and value-engineering opportunities.

faqs.question: Do you handle government approvals and permits?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our approvals team manages zoning, building permits, utility connections, and all statutory documentation on your behalf.

faqs.question: How do you keep projects on budget and on schedule?
faqs.answer: We use milestone-based budgeting, weekly site reporting, and a dedicated project manager so you always know exactly where your project stands.

service_details.title: Project Management
service_details.featured_alt: Project management team planning a construction build
about_paragraphs: Our comprehensive estimates also reflect available lower-price options, so you always choose with full confidence. Salam Properties takes complete ownership of planning, scheduling, procurement, and reporting, keeping complex builds moving forward without surprises.

From a single high-rise to a multi-phase master plan, our project managers act as your owner representative — coordinating consultants, contractors, and suppliers while protecting your budget, timeline, and quality standards.

why.heading: Why Choose Us
why.description: Disciplined planning, live reporting, and a single point of accountability that removes stress from even the most complex construction programs.

items.title: On-Time Delivery
items.desc: Milestone-based scheduling with critical-path tracking keeps your build moving to plan.

items.title: Cost Certainty
items.desc: Transparent estimates, tender comparison, and change-control processes eliminate budget surprises.

items.title: Vendor Coordination
items.desc: We manage architects, engineers, and contractors as one tightly coordinated team.

items.title: Clear Reporting
items.desc: Weekly progress reports and photo updates give you full visibility from anywhere in the world.

offerings.title: Project Planning & Scheduling
offerings.desc: Detailed work-breakdown structures, critical-path scheduling, and resource loading.

offerings.title: Budget & Cost Control
offerings.desc: Live cost tracking, tender evaluation, and value engineering at every design stage.

offerings.title: Contractor Procurement
offerings.desc: Competitive tendering, prequalification, and contract negotiation on your behalf.

offerings.title: Quality & Safety Management
offerings.desc: Independent site inspections and strict HSE compliance across all active work fronts.

offerings.title: Handover & Closeout
offerings.desc: Snagging, commissioning, documentation, and defect-liability management through handover.

faqs.question: Do you manage projects the client has already started?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly step into live projects to recover schedules, re-control budgets, and restore reporting discipline.

faqs.question: What reporting cadence do you provide?
faqs.answer: Clients receive weekly written progress reports with photos, plus milestone cost reports and immediate alerts on any critical risk.

faqs.question: Can you work with our own architect and engineers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We integrate seamlessly with your existing consultant team or help you appoint the right specialists.

faqs.question: How are your project management fees structured?
faqs.answer: Fees are typically a percentage of project value or a fixed monthly retainer, agreed transparently before mobilisation.

service_details.title: Investment & Capital
about_paragraphs: We are focused on improving the way capital projects get done. Salam Properties connects private and institutional investors with carefully vetted real estate opportunities that balance attractive yields with disciplined risk management.

Every opportunity in our portfolio is underwritten with independent valuation, legal due diligence, and realistic exit modelling — so your capital is deployed with clarity, confidence, and full regulatory compliance.

why.heading: Why Choose Us
why.description: Institutional-grade diligence, transparent structures, and a track record of delivering stable, well-secured returns across market cycles.

items.title: Vetted Opportunities
items.desc: Only projects passing legal, technical, and financial due diligence reach our investors.

items.title: Asset-Backed Security
items.desc: Investments secured against tangible real estate assets with clear title documentation.

items.title: Portfolio Balance
items.desc: Diversified options across residential, commercial, and land assets to match your risk profile.

items.title: Flexible Exits
items.desc: Defined exit windows, buy-back options, and secondary transfer support when you need liquidity.

offerings.title: Investment Advisory
offerings.desc: Personalised guidance built around your returns targets, horizon, and risk appetite.

offerings.title: Project Financing Structuring
offerings.desc: Debt-equity structuring, bank coordination, and Shariah-compliant options where required.

offerings.title: Due Diligence & Valuation
offerings.desc: Independent legal, technical, and valuation reports on every opportunity we present.

offerings.title: Joint Venture Partnerships
offerings.desc: Structured JV arrangements for landowners and developers seeking committed capital.

offerings.title: Portfolio Management
offerings.desc: Ongoing performance reporting, rental income management, and exit planning support.

faqs.question: What minimum investment do you accept?
faqs.answer: Entry points vary by project, but most opportunities start from BDT 25 lakh with clear documentation and defined terms.

faqs.question: How are returns paid to investors?
faqs.answer: Returns are paid via bank transfer according to the agreed schedule — typically quarterly rental income plus capital appreciation at exit.

faqs.question: Is my investment legally protected?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every investment is backed by registered agreements, and where applicable, by mortgage or title transfer held in trust.

faqs.question: Can I exit before the project completes?
faqs.answer: Most structures include a secondary transfer option, and we actively support early exits where contractually permitted.

service_details.title: Construction Management
service_details.featured_alt: Construction management on a modern building site
about_paragraphs: From design to operations, we love to solve complex challenges and exceed expectations. Our construction management practice brings rigorous site discipline, modern methods, and uncompromising safety to every build we deliver.

We supervise structure, finishes, MEP, and external works with independent quality checks at each stage — ensuring the finished building matches the approved drawings, specifications, and your quality expectations.

why.heading: Why Choose Us
why.description: Boots-on-the-ground supervision, proven safety systems, and quality verification at every stage of construction.

items.title: Expert Site Teams
items.desc: Resident engineers and supervisors with deep experience across high-rise and infrastructure builds.

items.title: Quality Assurance
items.desc: Material testing, slab approval, and multi-stage snag checks enforce spec-perfect delivery.

items.title: Safety First Culture
items.desc: Certified PPE, toolbox talks, and strict HSE audits keep every worker and visitor safe.

items.title: Supply Chain Control
items.desc: Vetted suppliers and just-in-season procurement prevent costly on-site delays.

offerings.title: Structural Works Supervision
offerings.desc: Foundation, RCC frame, and structural integrity monitoring by qualified engineers.

offerings.title: MEP Coordination
offerings.desc: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing coordination with clash-free coordinated drawings.

offerings.title: Finishes & Fit-Out Management
offerings.desc: Detailed finishes schedules, sample approvals, and craftsmanship inspections.

offerings.title: Safety & Compliance
offerings.desc: Full HSE management, statutory compliance, and incident-free site reporting.

offerings.title: Snagging & Defect Rectification
offerings.desc: Systematic snagging, defect liability management, and post-handover support.

faqs.question: Do you work with the client’s own contractors?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can act as an independent construction manager over contractors you appoint, or help you tender for the right team.

faqs.question: How do you verify material quality on site?
faqs.answer: All critical materials are checked against approved samples and test reports, with lab testing arranged where required.

faqs.question: What safety standards do you follow?
faqs.answer: We follow Bangladesh NBC guidelines alongside international HSE best practices, including mandatory PPE and weekly safety audits.

faqs.question: Do you provide post-handover support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every project includes a defined defect liability period with scheduled inspections and prompt rectification.

service_details.title: Architecture & Design
service_details.featured_alt: Architecture and design workspace with building plans
about_paragraphs: We believe good architecture is a crucial foundation that influences the overall performance of a real estate asset. Our design studio blends functional planning, climate-responsive detailing, and refined aesthetics into spaces people love to inhabit.

From concept sketches and 3D visualisation to complete construction-document packages, we deliver designs that are buildable, cost-aware, and unmistakably yours — without compromising on light, space, or character.

why.heading: Why Choose Us
why.description: Design that balances beauty, buildability, and budget — delivered by a studio that understands how buildings actually get constructed.

items.title: Concept to Detail
items.desc: Full-service design from master planning through detailed construction drawings.

items.title: 3D Visualisation
items.desc: Photorealistic 3D renders and walkthroughs so you approve the look before we build.

items.title: Climate-Responsive
items.desc: Passive ventilation, natural light, and shading strategies tuned to Bangladesh’s climate.

items.title: Space Efficiency
items.desc: Layouts engineered to maximise usable area, rental value, and resident comfort.

offerings.title: Concept & Master Planning
offerings.desc: Site-responsive master plans and architectural concepts aligned to your vision.

offerings.title: 3D Rendering & Walkthroughs
offerings.desc: Immersive visualisation packages for approvals, marketing, and investor presentations.

offerings.title: Interior Design
offerings.desc: Complete interior schemes — materials, lighting, joinery, and furniture layouts.

offerings.title: Structural & MEP Design
offerings.desc: Coordinated engineering designs ready for authority approval and construction.

offerings.title: Authority Approval Support
offerings.desc: RAJUK and municipal submission packages managed end-to-end by our design team.

faqs.question: How long does the design phase usually take?
faqs.answer: A typical residential or commercial concept takes 3–6 weeks, with detailed drawings following 4–8 weeks after concept approval.

faqs.question: Can you design within a fixed construction budget?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work backward from your target construction cost to size, specification, and structural system from day one.

faqs.question: Do you provide furniture and interior styling?
faqs.answer: Our interior studio covers everything from built-in joinery to loose furniture selection and styling.

faqs.question: Will you coordinate with my contractor during construction?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We remain involved for shop-drawing review, site queries, and design compliance checks during construction.

service_details.title: Sales & Marketing
service_details.featured_alt: Sales and marketing presentation for a property launch
about_paragraphs: Building a real estate development is a complicated task requiring both deep understanding of the product and the market it serves. Salam Properties’ sales and marketing division turns completed inventory into closed deals — with strategy, storytelling, and a trained sales force behind every launch.
From brand positioning and campaign creative to channel partnerships, booking management, and registration support, we manage the complete path from first enquiry to registered handover.

why.heading: Why Choose Us
why.description: Market-savvy positioning, a proven sales force, and transparent booking management that accelerates sell-out.

items.title: Targeted Campaigns
items.desc: Digital and traditional campaigns engineered around your specific buyer persona.

items.title: Trained Sales Force
items.desc: Professional sales consultants who convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.

items.title: Channel Network
items.desc: Deep relationships with agents, corporates, and NRB buyer networks nationwide.

items.title: Transparent Booking
items.desc: Digital booking records, clear payment schedules, and compliant registration support.

offerings.title: Brand & Positioning Strategy
offerings.desc: Naming, identity, and market positioning that differentiates your project at launch.

offerings.title: Launch Campaigns
offerings.desc: End-to-end launch planning — events, media buying, creative production, and PR.

offerings.title: Digital Marketing
offerings.desc: SEO, social media, and paid advertising tuned for maximum qualified enquiry volume.

offerings.title: Sales Team & Channel Management
offerings.desc: On-site sales teams, agent networks, and performance dashboards that keep selling.

offerings.title: Booking & Documentation
offerings.desc: Booking management, payment collection, BNBC compliance, and registration assistance.

faqs.question: When should marketing for a project begin?
faqs.answer: Ideally 3–6 months before launch. Early teaser campaigns build an enquiry pipeline that converts on day one.

faqs.question: Do you work on commission or retainer?
faqs.answer: We offer both — a launch retainer plus performance commission — structured around your project’s sales targets.

faqs.question: Can you handle NRB (overseas Bangladeshi) buyers?
faqs.answer: Yes. We run dedicated NRB campaigns with remote booking, video tours, and power-of-attorney registration support.

faqs.question: How do you report sales performance?
faqs.answer: Clients receive weekly dashboards covering enquiries, site visits, bookings, collections, and inventory status.

project_details.title: Mixed-Use Development
about_paragraphs: Mixed-Use Development is a landmark address in the heart of Gulshan, combining premium retail on the lower floors with elegant residences and corporate suites above. Designed for modern urban living, it places everything you need within a single, beautifully managed building.

From curated commercial frontages to spacious upper-floor residences, every square foot is planned for performance and comfort. Investors benefit from strong rental demand in Dhaka’s most established commercial district, while residents enjoy hotel-grade services and security.

faqs.question: Is a flexible payment plan available?
